title: Nada
scene: Italian musica leggera; Sanremo 1969 and late-sixties pop
notes: Youthful, forceful singing frames Sanremo melodies, orchestrated covers and occasional beat-band tracks.

title: Io l'ho fatto per amore
scene: Italian festival pop and international songs adapted into Italian
notes: Orchestral Italian pop and translated international songs precede Nada’s turn toward personal expression.

title: Ho scoperto che esisto anch'io
scene: Italian canzone d’autore; Piero Ciampi–Gianni Marchetti partnership
notes: Ciampi’s darkly ironic characters meet lush orchestration, guitar effects and fearless interpretive shifts.

title: 1930: Il domatore delle scimmie
scene: Italian songwriter pop with Reale Accademia di Musica; progressive-rock accents
notes: Pop songwriting meets a progressive band, sardonic fables, acoustic rhythms and bright rock piano.
